column1: # Access rules of the competitions whose entrants come by a fixed route (future testing, slice 2 of the 0.6.2 spec).
# Input of history_check.py. The finals classes take their team count and hosts from the table of the season code
# (src/recomp_rt/win/season_intl_table.c); after its last row a class keeps the count of that row (decision A).
# comp: a key of competitions.tsv or history_names.tsv. from, to: the edition years (to: a year or none).
# teams: the count of entrants. routes: ";" between the entrants, each the winner of a competition key, in the
# edition before the match or the one of its year (a super cup in August follows a final in May).

column6: UEFA Super Cup: the Champions League and Europa League (UEFA Cup) winners
